source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1949, p. 7 ("Nominations for county and rural councils")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Moira rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There was no contest: seven nominations were received for seven seats. The News-Letter names the one new member, R. Malcolmson. New member; no contest in the district. Returned unopposed.
